“嗯~~真好吃。”

夹了一筷子鱼肉，女孩两只眼睛幸福得眯起来。

看到施施一脸满足的表情，魏沐忍不住问道：‘你怎么跟老蔡说的？她会答应？’

“我跟她说回去看父母，请三天假。”

对方比了个三的手势。

“小刘同学，你胆子不小啊。”

“不然呢？你以为我是什么乖巧女孩吗？”

确实如此。

魏沐总是以未来的印象看瞎姐，那个时候的她已经是一线顶流，举止大方温婉。

实际上，骨子里却是一个假小子。

一边吃菜，一边喝红酒，魏沐买的红酒度数不高，刘施施喝了几口没感觉有什么反应。

难道说，我的酒量上涨？

见她又喝一杯，魏沐伸手劝道：“少喝一点，这酒度数虽然不高，喝多了会上头。”

“我不要。你以为我是谁？在家里，我爸都喝不过我！！”

她拍了拍胸脯，眼神带着自信。

你可拉倒吧，叔叔根本没认真喝。

吃完饭，刘施施已经有些醉了，为了不被笑话，她硬挺着保持清醒。

两个人挤在一起洗碗。

“你先去休息吧，我来洗碗。”

“没事一起洗。”

说是洗碗，魏老板的心思却不在洗碗上面，他轻轻靠在刘施施的背上，脑袋抵在对方一侧肩膀上。

“哎呀，你别乱动，你到底是洗碗还是摸我手？”

刘施施脸颊红得不行，说话的声音越来越小。

“你的手脏，我给你洗洗。”

洗完碗，刘施施腿已经软了。

她靠在沙发上休息一会，眼睛直勾勾的盯着坐在旁边看电视的坏男人。

你为什么这么熟练啊！！

是不是和王晓晨做过同样的事？

一想到王晓晨，她便一肚子火。

不管是谁，都会在意前任这种生物，瞎姐也不例外。

关键王晓晨长得好看，比她还小一岁！！

平心而论，她自认为长得不比王晓晨差。

转念一想，下意识低头看了看。

可惜在某些方面，永远比不上对方。

不过，她有一点比王晓晨强太多——跳芭蕾舞

毕竟是从小学到大的技能，在这一方面，刘施施非常有信心。

一顿胡思乱想，她看着魏沐的眼神多了一丝复杂。

“你在想什么？是不是在想前女友呢？”

"Hmm~~It's delicious."

After picking up a piece of fish with chopsticks, the girl's eyes narrowed in happiness.

Seeing the satisfied expression on Shi Shi's face, Wei Mu couldn't help but ask: 'What did you tell Lao Cai?Will she agree?’

"I told her to go back to see her parents and take three days off."

The other party made the sign of three.

"Classmate Xiao Liu, you are very courageous."

"Otherwise? Do you think I'm some nice girl?"

Indeed.

Wei Mu always looked at the blind sister with the impression of the future. At that time, she was already a top-notch person with a generous and gentle manner.

In fact, he is a tomboy at heart.

While eating vegetables, they drank red wine. The red wine Wei Mu bought was not high in alcohol content, so Liu Shishi didn't feel any reaction after taking a few sips.

Could it be that my drinking capacity has increased?

Seeing her drink another glass, Wei Mu stretched out his hand to persuade her: "Drink less. Although the alcohol content is not high, drinking too much will cause you to get sick."

"I don't want it. Who do you think I am? At home, my dad can't even drink from me!!"

She patted her chest with confidence in her eyes.

You can pull it off, uncle didn't drink seriously at all.

After eating, Liu Shishi was already a little drunk. In order not to be laughed at, she stayed awake.

Two people huddled together washing dishes.

"You go and rest first, I'll wash the dishes."

"It's okay to wash it together."

It was said that he was washing dishes, but Boss Wei's mind was not on washing dishes. He leaned gently on Liu Shishi's back and rested his head on one of his shoulders.

"Oh, don't move. Are you washing the dishes or touching my hand?"

Liu Shishi's cheeks were extremely red and his voice became softer and softer.

"Your hands are dirty, let me wash them for you."

After washing the dishes, Liu Shishi's legs were already weak.

She leaned on the sofa to rest for a while, staring straight at the bad man sitting next to her watching TV.

Why are you so skilled!!

Have you done the same thing as Wang Xiaochen?

When she thought of Wang Xiaochen, she became angry.

No matter who you are, you will care about your ex, and Blind Sister is no exception.

The key is that Wang Xiaochen is good-looking and one year younger than her!!

To be fair, she thinks she looks no worse than Wang Xiaochen.

After a second thought, I subconsciously looked down.

It's a pity that in some aspects, they can never compare to each other.

However, she is much better than Wang Xiaochen in one thing - ballet dancing

After all, it is a skill learned from elementary school. Liu Shishi is very confident in this aspect.

After thinking wildly for a while, she looked at Wei Mu with a more complicated expression.

"What are you thinking about? Are you thinking about your ex-girlfriend?"
